description: This file defines functions for converting HTTP/2 protocol constants and enums to string representations, including frame types, flags, error codes, and settings parameters. It also manages invalid header names according to HTTP/2 specifications.

classes.name: InvalidHeaderSet
classes.description: A set representing invalid HTTP/2 header names, used for validation according to RFC 7540.

methods.name: Http2FrameTypeToString
methods.description: Converts an Http2FrameType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: Http2FrameTypeToString
methods.description: Overloaded function that converts a uint8_t to Http2FrameType and then to string.

methods.name: Http2FrameFlagsToString
methods.description: Converts frame type and flags to a human-readable string.

methods.name: Http2FrameFlagsToString
methods.description: Overloaded function that converts type and flags from uint8_t to string.

methods.name: Http2ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts an error code to its string representation.

methods.name: Http2ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Overloaded function that converts Http2ErrorCode enum to string.

methods.name: Http2SettingsParameterToString
methods.description: Converts a settings parameter value to its string name.

methods.name: Http2SettingsParameterToString
methods.description: Overloaded function that converts Http2SettingsParameter enum to string.

methods.name: GetInvalidHttp2HeaderSet
methods.description: Returns a set of invalid HTTP/2 header names based on current configuration flags.
